metrics_finding.finding: inventory-service CPU utilization increased from baseline to failure, while memory utilization decreased.

evidence_summary.summary: Inventory service CPU utilization increased from baseline to failure, while memory utilization decreased.

report.suggested_fix: Check inventory service configuration for CPU and memory settings.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is likely due to a misconfiguration in the inventory service, causing an increase in CPU utilization and a decrease in memory utilization. It is recommended to check the configuration for CPU and memory settings.
report_text.hi: अप्रत्याशित घटना की मूल स्थिति संभवतः इनवेंट्री सेवा में एक गलत सेटिंग है, जिससे प्रोसेसर उपयोग बढ़ता है और यादृच्छिकता उपयोग कम होता है। इसकी जांच करने की सलाह दी गई है.
